title: Joshua the high priest cleansed before the angel of the LORD (fourth night vision)

symbols.symbol: The satan (the adversary) at Joshua's right hand
symbols.in_text_interpretation: Rebuked by the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem (3:2).

symbols.symbol: Filthy garments replaced with rich robes and a clean turban
symbols.in_text_interpretation: "I have caused your iniquity to pass from you" (3:4).

symbols.symbol: A burning stick plucked from the fire

symbols.in_text_interpretation: The LORD will engrave it and remove the land's iniquity in one day (3:9).

description: Joshua stands before the angel of the LORD in filthy garments with the satan accusing him; the LORD rebukes the accuser; Joshua is cleansed, given a clean turban, promised charge of the LORD's house, and told of "my servant the Branch" and a stone with seven eyes.
